label: Best months
value: April to October; April and May for green slopes, June to August for the peak
quote: the main tourist season for Swat begins in spring and lasts till autumn (April to October)

label: Winter
value: Snow season is December to February, when the valley is for snow lovers
quote: Winter (December to February): For snow lovers and skiing in Malam Jabba.
source: Bloom Pakistan, Islamabad to Swat travel guide 2025

label: Altitude
value: About 1,435 m (4,708 ft) at the town

label: From Mingora
value: About 60 km north of Mingora, on the Kalam road (N-95)

label: Night driving
value: Avoid night travel on the mountain road after Chakdara (fog, narrow turns)
quote: Avoid night travel due to fog and narrow turns.
source: Bloom Pakistan, Islamabad to Swat travel guide 2025

label: Where to stay
value: Riverside resorts; a base for the trail to Daral and Saidgai lakes
quote: It also serves as a base camp for the trail that leads to the Daral and Saidgai lakes.
